node.title: Re^3: Extracting selected fields form file record (don't use File::Slurp References)
node.author: eyepopslikeamosquito
node.doctext:
Noone even mentioned [mod://File::Slurp]! :)

If you must use a module for this, may I suggest [mod://Path::Tiny] or [mod://File::Slurper]? See File::Slurp is broken and wrong by Leon Timmermans for why.

... though I agree with [haukex] [id://11141231|below] that it's better to do it idiomatically without a module: my $string = do { local $/; <$fh> }

File Slurping References

  • [id://1217182] by [haukex] (2018) - prior discussion of this problem
  • [id://309205] by me (2003) - crusty old code that contained a simple slurp_file function

References Added Later

  • [id://11155561] by [cormanaz] (2023) - got an out of memory error slurping a half-gig file with [mod://File::Slurp]
  • [id://11155572] by me (2023) - after being provoked by [Bod] I advised him to never use [mod://File::Slurp]
  • [id://11155579] by [hippo] (2023) - ... suggested [Bod] try [mod://Path::Tiny] instead of [mod://File::Slurp]
  • [id://11160336] by [vincentaxhe] (2024) - expressed surprise that [mod://Path::Tiny] could be used to slurp files
  • [id://11160652] by [Veraellyunjie] (2024) - slurping files with raku slurp, replies mention Perl 5 [mod://File::Slurper] and [mod://File::Slurp]
